query: INSERT INTO manifestations (work_id, format, file_path, ingestion_file_hash, current_file_hash, file_size_bytes, ingestion_status, validation_status) SELECT w.id, 'epub'::manifestation_format, '/tmp/bulk-' || w.id, 'bulk-hash-' || w.id, 'bulk-hash-' || w.id, 1000, 'complete'::ingestion_status, 'clean'::validation_status FROM works w
